name: Camp Pendleton State Military Reservation (Virginia Beach)
notes: Not mapped. DWR's Military Areas list (Fort A.P. Hill, Fort Pickett, Fort Belvoir, JBLE-Fort Eustis, MCB Quantico) leaves it out, and no state or Guard source offers hunting there. It is a small, built-up beachfront post in Virginia Beach. DCR's layer gives public access as 'by arrangement with landowner'. (Search results for 'Camp Pendleton hunting' are all about the Marine Corps base in California.)

name: Other Virginia National Guard sites (DCR 'National Guard Site' polygons; armories, Army Aviation Support Facility, etc.)
